Definition: properly, wrestled; but used (in the plural) transitively, a struggle
BiblicalUsage: Naphthul is wrestling or a struggle, and its only occurrence is the naming of Naphtali. In Genesis 30:8 Rachel says, with great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed, and she calls his name Naphtali.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the struggle in the name is honest, because Rachel did not hide the wrestling that gave her a son; a name that remembers a fight is a name that remembers God heard it.
